title: The Best Wi-Fi Smart Blinds and Curtains
subtitle: Motorized shades, blind kits, and curtain tracks with app and voice control, ranked.
intro: We pulled the Wi-Fi smart blinds and curtain systems on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features. Several popular shades use a radio remote plus a Wi-Fi hub; the table shows which.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: Retrofit robot or new motorized shade?
buyers_guide.a: Curtain robots and blind tilters attach to what you already have and install in minutes. Motorized shades replace your blinds and look cleaner, but you have to measure and order to size.
Most use a rechargeable battery charged over USB-C or a small solar panel. Expect weeks to months per charge depending on use.
Bluetooth robots need a hub for remote control and automations. Zigbee motors need a Zigbee hub. Wi-Fi models connect directly.
